items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Could Be 16% Undervalued As Board Adds BlackRock Veteran

The role will be effective from January 2027. Recent trading has been choppy for S&P Global, with the share price down 7.18% over the past week and the year-to-date share price return falling 14.26%, while the 3-year total shareholder return of 14.70% points to much steadier long-run momentum. items.title: Fear and 'Hot Sauce': Young Investors Want To Catch Up
items.summary: Buzzy stocks, leveraged ETFs, and a generation feeling left behind. BlackRock's Gargi Chaudhuri discusses ways investors can dabble in risky products while also leaning into time-proven strategies. On this week's "Bloomberg Money", she joins Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu, who gives a shoutout to @Eric Balchunas and his coverage of 'hot sauce' investment products.

items.title: Why Is Wells Fargo (WFC) Losing A $1.3 Billion Team While Bitcoin ETF Holdings Grow?
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) has lost a multigenerational financial advisor group overseeing about US$1.3b in client assets to &Partners. The departing wealth management team had been based at Wells Fargo and served clients across multiple generations within families. Separately, Wells Fargo has doubled client holdings in BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF while the wider bitcoin ETF market has seen outflows.
